basic_info.description: Love, it seems, can't be priced - but this charming home in San Francisco's Outer Richmond neighborhood comes close. Nestled between two MUNI lines, you'll enjoy easy access to top schools, hiking trails, beaches, and an easy trip to downtown.    Inside, you'll find a 2-bedroom, 3-bathroom haven with four walk-in closets and an in-law bonus room. The real showstopper, though, is the sprawling backyard - perfect for gardening, hosting events, or simply enjoying some fresh air. A cleverly repurposed shed (currently a cantina) adds to the property's flexibility.    With its RH2 zoning, this home offers endless possibilities for growth and customization. And with top schools, parks, and outdoor spaces nearby, come see how great life is in the Richmond District!
